text:
Zara Khan: quick one  final loop candidate Priya N. asked about childcare stipend because their partner can't cover evening. interview 6:30pm-8:30pm. can we offer a stipend or suggest a nearby sitter?
Logan Price: we have a standard candidate-care stipend policy up to $80 for last-minute childcare. Approve?
Zara Khan: approve the $80 stipend. also need hotel for overnight; coming from out of town.
Travel Desk: we can book Nightbridge Inn (corporate rate $150) single night. confirm and we'll charge the corporate card.
Zara Khan: please book Nightbridge. add a quiet room; note: candidate prefers ground-floor.
Reception: After-hours arrival protocol: enter via East Lobby after 6pm, show photo ID. Call desk at +1-555-303-9000 and text "Priya N - arrived" to expedite badge. We'll pre-print a visitor pass.
Zara Khan: do we have an escort for 6:20pm meet?
Panel Scheduler: I can meet at 6:15pm in East Lobby and escort to Conf A. Adding 6:10pm meetup to calendar.
People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted for Priya Narang. Badge ETA: 15m after check-in. Childcare stipend note logged. Expense instructions: Candidate forward sitter receipt to expenses@redwood.ai with subject `Candidate Childcare - Priya Narang - [date]`. Reimburse within 3 business days.
Logan Price: also parking  candidate may drive. We can hold one visitor hangtag. Need plate by 3pm today to print permit.
Zara Khan: I'll DM Priya requesting plate # and whether they want rideshare voucher instead.
Catering: dietary note? we can provide boxed dinner for candidate and panelists. Any restrictions?
Zara Khan: Priya is pescatarian + prefers dairy-free. Please label meal clearly.
Travel Desk: hotel booked Nightbridge Inn confirmation #NB-4421. Folio link added to calendar invite. Ground-floor room confirmed.
Reception: we'll have a printed visitor map and a spare phone charger for the candidate at the desk.
Logan Price: small ask for the panel  confirm whether you need remote backup if candidate is delayed >20m.
Panel Scheduler: panel confirmed; Zoom backup link added to invite.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: if vendor sitter was booked by Redwood, create vendor-payment ticket using template `Expense Type: Childcare; Amount: $XX; Candidate: Priya Narang; Approver: Logan Price`. If candidate paid, reimburse via expenses email.
Zara Khan: perfect  I'll DM Priya the meet spot, front desk number, and childcare reimbursement note. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Reception: Noted  we'll hold the hangtag and visitor pass, and have the boxed dinner ready at 6:10pm at Conf A.
People Ops Bot: This thread will be archived after 7 days per channel retention settings.
